def molecule = molecules.builder("guide:salt")
molecule.name("Sodium chloride")
molecule.formula("NaCl")
def fragment1 = molecules.structureBuilder()
fragment1.atom("Na", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
fragment1.atomConfiguration(0, new AtomicConfiguration(11, 12, 1, java.util.List.of(2, 8)))

fragment1.atom("Cl", 2.82, 2.82, 2.82)
fragment1.atomConfiguration(4, new AtomicConfiguration(17, 18, -1, java.util.List.of(2, 8, 8)))
fragment1.atom("Cl", 2.82, 0.0, 0.0)
fragment1.atomConfiguration(5, new AtomicConfiguration(17, 18, -1, java.util.List.of(2, 8, 8)))
